content: Coming Nov 17 --- Azeroth is calling, and this time, the story is yours to forge. D&D: World of Warcraft brings the storied MMO world from desktop to tabletop, where your choices shape every battle, every alliance, and every legend. Recreate your main player character, roll a new alt, or play a hero the world has never seen. #dnd #dungeonsanddragons
